population: 20 old development roots; selected pure-Python releases on one Linux/CPython profile
primary_control_coupling: Shared parsing, identity and conservative marker/activation semantics; independent direct interpretation, no certificates
multiple_testing: Holm; six frozen method/metric contrasts per analysis panel
reference_scope: Coordinate-level frozen installed labels; ambiguous occurrence changes remain unknown
reference_access: outer scorer only, after all prediction matrices are sealed and verified
context_profile: All installed distributions contribute base requirements; captured extra seeds have explicit completeness state
guarded_upper_activation: Unparsed installed parents may activate extras; never silently discarded as irrelevant
evidence_authority: Trusted local collector and context author; no signature or deployment attestation implied

human_audit.sampling: up to 40 add, retract, abstain; hash seed 42

empirical_advantage_gate: If V2 ties the strong semantic control in every complete development case, do not launch a held-out accuracy-superiority study for this version

external_comparators.sbom_unifier_native_scope: Existing reproduction, not a new V2 comparison
